body: Business card size, matte black, 10 boxes, hole punch. Any purchase punches a box. Free item ≤$8. No expiration. No registration. Stack on counter next to soap. Emily Prime tracks only reorder at 500-card threshold.
title: S157-01: STINKIES Rewards punch card — buy 10 get 1 free, no app, no data, paper card $0.03/unit
